geometry.unit: 12 equal horizontal units; vertical units same physical length

emmaus.texture: 18 parallel folded edge cuts on each plate's inner side; width derived from unit; no ink in central opening

library.texture: 40 parallel engraved page edges projected between the two unfolded equal square impressions

rules.mobile: <=740px canvas: unfold both original square impressions vertically; no forced geometric rotation or cropped content; engraving removed if edge loses meaning
rules.type: existing OS with actual local Bodoni SC and Chiron 200/900 subset; no font change to OS
rules.navigation: reuse existing small marks and crests, destination-labelled links, no arrow
rules.content: Luke 24 chapter excerpt and six route entries copied from static/one/luke-21-24.js; Dawn Books original folio heading and catalogue images (not asserted as Jerusalem exhibition titles)
rules.line: only fold/edge generated texture and functional separators on editorial extension
rules.motherform: original scripture.html copy, only style and body class changed; V18 remains review-only; no production use
